planets.name: HAT-P-26 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Guahayona with a 4.23-day year, found in 2010.

text.card: HAT-P-26 b was found in 2010 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Guahayona. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
